ask_brink.Text: I will take the final test.

bracer.Text: Tell me more about that bracer.

refuse.Text: Forget about it. I'm not going to participate in any of your tests.

carry_on.Text: Sounds reasonable. Carry on with your testing, Drake.

where_donna.Text: Where can I find Donna Red?

where_veronica.Text: Where can I find Veronica Escobar?

Text: To measure your strength, we want to see you defeat three creatures.
{delay 1}\nI am uploading the details right now.{givequest XDS0}
{delay 1}\nThey are all, as described in the briefing, located in this area.
{delay 2}\nReturn for evaluation when you have completed your assignment.
{delay 2}{emote}Drake nods his head and lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}I am sending the specimen on test one. Track its progress. Rodriguez out.

busy_strength.Text: A Deceitful Weaver, a Shining Coiler and a Beit Gras. They are all located in this area. Return for evaluation when you have completed your assignment.

Text: Take this biomarker. Tag a Hungry Predator, a Lurking Chimera and a Pond Dryad. Target each one up close.
{delay 1}The reward is a Protective Shirt of Exploration.

{spawn QBMS 1}{givequest XDA0}To measure your agility and stamina we want you to register the location of certain rare species and return with the biomarker sensor for evaluation within given time. I am uploading the details right now.
{delay 2}{emote}Drake nods his head and lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}I am sending the specimen to test two. Track its progress.
{delay 1}\nRodriguez out.

busy_agility.Text: Tag a Hungry Predator, a Lurking Chimera and a Pond Dryad.

offer_sense.Text: A Shadowleet is hiding in the grass near the start of the grounds. Get close and target it. On retail it is invisible until you search; here you can see it.

Text: To measure your sensitivity in these surroundings we want you to find a shadowleet.
{delay 1}\nThe shadowleet is usually in hiding. I would suggest searching for it near the weavers.
{delay 1}\nI am uploading the details right now.{givequest XDN0}
{delay 2}\nReturn for evaluation when you are done.
These supplies go to Scientist Sarah Willis. An Imp Disruptor guards her crevice.
{delay 1}Assistant Brad Willis is outside. Target him, then target Sarah and leave the supplies. The reward is a Bonfire Kit.
{spawn QSUP 1}{givequest XDI0}To measure your intelligence we want you to contact one of our fellow scientists working out in the field.
{delay 1}\nShe may be hard to find, but that is part of the test.
{delay 1}\nShe may be found in a cave. The entrance is guarded, so beware.
{delay 1}\nYou are to give her these supplies...
{delay 2}\nDetails of your assignment should be uploaded by now.
{delay 1}\nReturn here for evaluation when you are done.
{delay 2}{emote}Drake turns his head away from you and whispers.{/emote}
{delay 1}The specimen is heading out for a test.
{delay 1}\nYes, I have high hopes for this one, but remember... Don't get too attached.
{delay 1}\nTrack its progress.
{delay 1}\nRodriguez out.

busy_mind.Text: Target Brad Willis, then Sarah Willis.

Text: Out at the brink, kill the Heckler of Evolution. It drops six Delicate Metal Devices.
{delay 1}Bring all six back. The other rock piles are Hecklers of Nature. Leave them if you only need the device.
{givequest XDBR}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.
{completequest XDBR}What the...
{delay 1}{emote}Drake lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}Hold everything, Donna! You too, Veronica! The specimen found something useful here.
{delay 1}{emote}He turns back to you.{/emote}
{delay 1}{name}, what you found here is truly amazing.
{delay 1}{emote}Drake gently brushes away some dust from the device, revealing ancient symbols.{/emote}
{delay 1}These symbols clearly indicate the involvement of intellectually advanced beings.
{delay 1}\nPossibly an entire civilization!
{delay 1}{emote}He tries to translate the symbols.{/emote}
{delay 2}I'm sorry, {name}. I can only make out one word.
{delay 1}\nEr...
{delay 1}...Goh...?
{delay 2}\nNo, wait.
{delay 1}\nErgo.
{delay 1}\nYes, that's it. Whatever that means...
{delay 1}{emote}Drake reaches into a backpack.{/emote}
As promised, {name}. Your reward...
{delay 1}\nTalk to Donna Red or Veronica Escobar if you want to further aid us in our research.
{delay 1}{emote}Drake turns around and continues to investigate the strange device. You repeat the word a couple of times. Ergo.... Ergo. Why does it sound so familiar?{/emote}

handin_brink.Text: Let's see it, then. Put it in the trade window.{opentrade}

busy_brink.Text: Six Delicate Metal Devices from the Heckler of Evolution.

full.Text: Your hands are full. Make some room in your inventory first.{close}

Text: {emote}Drake pulls out a printed contract and waves it in front of you.{/emote}
{delay 1}Take a look!
{delay 2}\nYou agreed to let us examine the effects of environmental contaminants introduced to both your body and mind through carefully conducted tests, as part of the experiment.
{delay 1}\nWhy, I have never heard of anyone refusing these tests - considering the rewards!
This bracer was constructed to measure your performance during our examinations. It is extremely important that you wear one throughout your entire trial period here with us in Nascence.
{delay 1}Right-click the Bracer to get warped back to Drake from anywhere in the training grounds.

refuse.Text: Noted. The offer stands when you change your mind.{close}

Text: {givequest XDPR}
Then that test is ready to close. Speak to me again and I will record it.
{completequest XDPR}{dropquest XDPF}{dropquest XDPC}{dropquest XDE0}{dropquest XDC0}{spawn QBRJ 1}Well done, {name}. Let me have a look at your bracer.
{delay 1}{emote}Drake seems to register some values from your bracer.{/emote}
{delay 1}Well done, {name}!
{delay 1}\nAll values are to our satisfaction. Here is your reward, and a fresh bracer in case Celeth-El kept the other one.
{delay 1}\nYou may now continue with the other tests.

nothing.Text: The tests are done. Nascence is through the way you came, when you are ready.{close}

Text: {givequest XDGK}{completequest XDGK}{spawn QBRJ 1}I am Drake Rodriguez and I will be handling your case today. Here, take this standard issue gear. You'll need it for your mandatory examination.
{delay 1}{emote}You notice that Drake is holding a bracer.{/emote}
{delay 1}{emote}Drake nods his head slightly and covertly lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}We have a healthy specimen here. I will take him through the usual tests before we send him to the brink. Rodriguez out.
{delay 1}You can open your inventory by pressing 'I' or using the inventory icon on your gui.
\nAre you ready?

rewards.Text: \nEvery test you pass is paid for, in credits and in equipment. The bracer will see to it that nothing goes unrecorded.

Text: Excellent. You'll be well compensated for your trouble, of course.
{delay 1}\nLet's begin!
To measure your psychic abilities we want to investigate the consequences of exposing your mind to the unknown.
{delay 1}\nTwo encampments have been found. One west and one east of here.
{delay 1}\nThey will each present you with a problem, but you should only help one of them.
{delay 1}\nI will now upload details to your NCU concerning the first part of this test, which will be to locate the representatives from both sides.{givequest XDPF}{givequest XDPC}
{delay 2}\nAdditional details will be uploaded to you when you decide on who to help.
{delay 1}\nReturn for evaluation when you are done.
{delay 1}\nChoose you path carefully, {name}.
{delay 2}{emote}Drake lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}The specimen is now heading for test four.
Last I heard she was somewhere in Nascence.
{delay 1}\nHead on through Jobe Research and you will find Nascence Frontier.
{delay 1}\nThat's where I would look.
{delay 1}\nNow if you'll excuse me...{close}
Donna went out into Nascence. Head on through Jobe Research to Nascence Frontier and ask around.
{delay 1}\nNow if you'll excuse me...{close}
